payload.title: stance workers carry a comment-stripped clip
payload.body: unit stance-workers-lean left judgeClipShell byte-identical in stance-guardrail.ts because purview-guardrail.ts still interpolates it and purview-guardrail.sh is byte-locked and outside that unit's outputs. The two stance workers interpolate a derived stanceGuardrailJudgeClipLean (the same shell, full-line comments stripped), a third export beside stanceGuardrailJudgeCap and stanceGuardrailJudgeClip. When purview-contest has copied the clip into guard-shell.ts with its comments cut, unit stance-contest should move all three consumers to that one comment-free copy and delete the Clip and ClipLean exports with the derivation.
